aireadiness.why: Scoring your own list of ideas on a 2x2 teaches prioritisation; the readiness scorecard is a document you fill in with the sponsor.

golive.why: Go-live is a sequence of gates you should see at once, then practise with a cutover plan and UAT sheet you fill in.

supportops.why: Triaging practice tickets builds severity and routing judgement; the support model and escalation matrix is a document you fill in.

incidents.why: An incident is a sequence in time; stepping through it, then running a timed drill with a comms timer, builds the habits.

enablement.why: Enablement is planned and run through documents: role goals, trust guides, a prompt library and a CoE charter you fill in.
